title: Playboy Magazine 1970 Lot of 4 Feb May July December Vintage Back Issue
descriptionText:
Issues Included

* February 1970
* May 1970
* July 1970
* December 1970

Condition

Acceptable vintage condition. These magazines show age and storage wear including cover wear, creasing, edge/corner wear, discoloration and other imperfections. December has notably heavier cover wear/scuffing. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and completeness.

Description

Vintage Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 – 1970

Includes four original 1970 issues: February, May, July and December.

These are over 50 years old and show varying degrees of age and handling wear. They contain period articles, photography, illustrations and vintage advertising, making them interesting pieces of 1970s publishing and pop-culture history.

The December issue has considerably more exterior wear than the others, as shown.

You will receive the exact four magazines pictured. Please use the photos as part of the condition description.
